messages:
anna_cs: Heads-up — MistralTech usage dropped ~68% over last 7 days, billing alert for unexpected overage this morning. New CTO (joined last week) has pinged procurement asking for cost/latency comparison. Sam, can you take lead on outreach?

sam_am: On it. Reached out to new CTO (cc @mike_sales). Asked for quick sync, offered 30m this week.

mike_sales: I had a short call yesterday; CTO is focused on license consolidation and brought in a small infra team. They want a competitive cost matrix and a perf run.

jasmin_fin: Finance flagged the overage invoice — holding renewals until we clarify billing trend. I put a temporary hold on auto-renew alerts.

priya_se: I can spin up a dedicated perf report and a 1-hour sandbox with fixed token cap for a controlled demo. Need the customer's preferred seq len and eval prompts.

anna_cs: Priya — can you grab the last 30 days of token distribution + top 5 endpoints used? Link: https://redwood.internal/ops/mistraltech/usage?range=30d

monitor-bot: Billing ticket #BIL-4728 created by jasmin_fin at 2024-04-15T09:12Z.

sam_am: Scheduled 30m call with CTO for Thu 10am PT. Agenda: billing explain, perf matrix, migration concerns. @priya_se pls prepare perf brief and quick cost-by-route snapshot.

priya_se: Will prepare. Quick Q — do we include quantized model variants and Dedicated pricing?

mike_sales: Yes, include Dedicated and Private options plus fallback plan if capacity spikes. Also add any promos for committed capacity.

anna_cs: Action items: Sam leads call + invite exec sponsor, Priya prepares perf + cost brief, Jasmin to draft billing note & clean invoice history, Mike to prep commercial options. I'll follow up with a customer health email after the call.

sam_am: Noted. I'll update this thread after call with next steps. :thumbsup:
